import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
# State rows start after 'United States' and end before 'Note:'
us_idx = df[df[0] == 'United States'].index[0]
note_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('Note:')].index[0]

states_df = df.iloc[us_idx + 1:note_idx].dropna(subset=[0]).copy()
states_df = states_df[~states_df[1].isin(['-', None])]
states_df['sales'] = states_df[1].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

top_3 = states_df.sort_values(by='sales', ascending=False).head(3)[0].tolist()
result = top_3
